agents.reasoning: Round 2 (supervisor fact-checks plus a direct read of the AT&T Q3 call transcript, 10-Q R63/R17 and FCC auction notes). Evidence: Q3 2026 revenue $32.3B (+5.3%), adj. EBITDA $12.5B (+5.4%), adj. EPS $0.65, FCF ~$5.0B; 379k postpaid phone adds, churn 0.92%; postpaid phone ARPU +4% from new/refreshed plans and back-book pricing with promotions unchanged (call); fiber ARPU -4% with Q4 similar and "relatively stable ARPU" over 2026-28 (CFO). GAAP EPS $0.12-0.13 carries a $2.6B Mexico impairment and an ~$800M separation charge whose cash lands mainly in 2027. Guides: 2026 EPS ~$2.40, AC EBITDA mid-to-high single digits, consolidated EBITDA 5%+ in 2028, FCF $18B+/$19B+/$21B+, capital investment $22-23B in 2027-28, $24B+ buybacks, 2.5x leverage in 2029. Price moves: Oct 9 (-10.8%) = SpaceX buying Grain's 800 MHz licences (no ex-dividend effect: ex-date Oct 12); Oct 21 (-6.4%) = results day (phone-add miss, capex/working-capital framing), a small earnings-path change; Oct 23 (-8.0%) = Bloomberg report of SpaceX seeking 80,000+ sites, a multiple effect. What changed from round 1: Forged Fiber stake $4,058M x 0.9 (R63) instead of $2.58B; separation cash no longer double-counted in net debt (horizon $147.9B, now linked to driver FCF); wireless ARPU +1.5%/+0.8% (was +0.6%/+0.4%); fiber ARPU -1.0%/+0.5% (was +0.7%/+1.6%); AC EBITDA +6.0%/+6.0%; interest +$0.1B; upper C-band -$5B x 0.35; P/E 8.1x and FCF yield 12.3% held at today's levels (were 8.5x / 12.0%); EPS, FCF/share and horizon net debt are now computed from the drivers through driver_build.set. Peers: Kilian's 12 incumbents on CY2027E, after leases: EV/EBITDA median 5.52x (5.98x ex-DT), P/E 10.55x; AT&T 5.78x / 7.98x on that basis. Result: research target (12m) $23.88 (EV/EBITDA $23.43, P/E $24.37, FCF $24.26); bear $15.15 (price war, 5.3x), bull $29.23 (6.9x). Guidance record: EPS first guides met or beaten 3 of 3 (median +2.7%), FCF floors 3 of 3 (+3.75%); we sit just below the 2027 FCF floor ($18.9B) and the 2028 EBITDA 5% (4.7% ex-Mexico) because of Legacy and fiber ARPU, and above the 2028 EPS floor on buybacks. Ladder: 60% the scenario mixture (lognormal, 15% within-scenario vol), 40% a neutral 28%-vol distribution centred near spot, because the October de-rating came from SpaceX headlines that may continue and momentum is negative; median ~$22.8, P(>= $21) 0.605.
